growth_quota_sensitivity.note: Only Bank depth changes. Capital quote and conversion stay fixed; not a joint price/rate/Pons growth forecast.

sequential_deposit_stress.assumption: Only sequential $80 buys; rate stays 51. No organic trading or fees buyback.
